stages.name: source-walks-debug
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --lib two_bit_generation::source_walk_tests -- --test-threads=1

stages.name: source-fetch-tests
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --lib sq8_s3_range::tests -- --test-threads=1

stages.name: baseline-tests
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --bin check_cohere_native_baseline -- --test-threads=1

stages.name: reducer-tests
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --example compare_native_replay -- --test-threads=1

stages.name: affected-release
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo build --locked --release -p borsuk --bin check_cohere_native_baseline --example compare_native_replay

stages.name: workspace-clippy
stages.command: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious

stages.name: workspace-test-build
stages.command: env -u BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_COMMAND CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_JOBS=1 bash scripts/check_rust_test_build.sh

scope: Compiler and synthetic source-cache correctness only. No cache performance, serving RAM, cold vendor or production-readiness claim.
